title: 10 Things a Godly Man Doesn't Let Run Him
caption:
An undefended man is just an open door.

His hunger, his temper, his eyes, his thumb. Left alone, every one of them will run the day for him. A godly man doesn't manage his impulses. He puts walls up before they're tested, not after.

The prayer he skips is never neutral. It's a door left open. Run your life, or something else will.

#faith #selfcontrol #godlyman #christianmen #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
